independent_probes.method: every probe runs the real checker CLI on a fresh TemporaryDirectory copy of the candidate tree; the owner tree is never written; each probe is run either with the fences re-frozen (so only a semantic rule can still reject it) or with the fences left alone (so a rejection proves only that the frozen hash noticed). The two modes are what let the review separate 'rejected by the frozen hash' from 'rejected by an actual rule'.

test_quality_assessment.how: every test drives the real CLI through subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', CHECKER, '--root', ...]); no test calls the internal check functions directly, so the CLI entry point, the argument parsing and the exit codes are all covered
test_quality_assessment.fixture_discipline: the synthetic package tree is built under pytest tmp_path and the real owner tree is only copied; test_canonical_package_validates_read_only and test_checker_is_read_only hash the canonical files before and after the run and assert they are unchanged
test_quality_assessment.owner_artefact_coverage: the owner_copy fixture copies the real owner artefacts into a temporary directory, mutates one artefact and lets the real checker decide on that copy (8 such tests)
test_quality_assessment.d0_code_m01_family: the empty control list bypass is covered by behavioural negative tests (empty allowed_files, empty commands, empty forbidden_write_paths, empty review allowed_files), not by constant comparisons
weak_points_observed: test_d0_packet_pin_is_the_owner_supplied_111_digest only compares a literal against a module constant; the behavioural companion (the stale 1.1 pin must fail) does carry the real weight
the synthetic suite must override --d0-packet-manifest-sha256, so the default hardcoded pin is exercised only by the tests that run against the real root
the suite mirrors the implementation's own guards, so it cannot reveal a guard that was never written - which is exactly what probes P01, P02 and P05 exposed
test_quality_assessment.verdict: the suite is genuine, CLI-level and behaviour-driven; it is not a count-only artefact. Its weakness is coverage, not style: three semantically wrong packages (P01, P02, P05) pass the whole suite.

limitations: This is an offline design and tool review. It is not product acceptance, not product Gate 0, not a Stage PASS and not a human signature.
The product coordinate stays R1 / WAIT_HUMAN; the 621b1bf experience signature is still absent; the samples stay NOT_MATERIALIZED_NOT_FROZEN and the MS cases, the V1-M1 stage and R22 stay NOT_RUN.
The checker validates plan and contract STRUCTURE. It never runs product code, never opens the product database, never produces a runtime ETag header and never materializes a sample.

The candidate migration SQL was parsed as text only and never executed. The DDL that defines lvw_scene_hash is not part of the frozen package, so the scene hash could only be verified against the declared prose rule, never against a shipped function.
The effective OpenAPI was replayed in memory by the reviewer's own code; no effective OpenAPI document was generated or shipped.

jsonschema 4.23.0 was importable in this environment and the full metaschema check and the retained-frame instance probe therefore ran. On a host without jsonschema the checker degrades silently - see NM-4. The optional fallback was verified honestly and no omitted validation is reported as a product PASS.
The implementation's provider and model identity is self-reported and was not independently verified.

The supplementary verify_pack count differs by one from the candidate's log and by 68 from its receipt prose; the cause is explained (MANIFEST.sha256 line count) but it was not reproduced to the byte.
The 43 probes are a bounded independent selection, not an exhaustive enumeration of every input the checker accepts; the reviewer does not claim the remaining untested inputs are clean.
